observations: A dark/off flat-panel monitor on a stand, bezel reads 'FLATRON' at top and 'LG' logo at bottom center.
Monitor is resting on two inverted metal pot lids/trays, not a desk, suggesting a staged or improvised setup.
A black full-size keyboard sits in front of the monitor; no visible brand text on the keyboard.
Screen is black/off in the photo, giving no indication of power-on state or screen condition.
Background shows a plastic chair and bare room, consistent with a home sale, no studio or shop setting.
No cables, power brick, or VGA/HDMI cable visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Scrap LG monitor and keyboard available for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the monitor powered off; 'scrap' is the seller's own characterization and cannot be confirmed or denied from a static photo.

risks.risk: Monitor may not power on or may have a dead/cracked screen.
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the screen powered on showing a clear image.

risks.risk: Keyboard keys or connector may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the keyboard typing on a working PC, or a close-up of the cable/connector.

risks.risk: Missing power adapter or video cable, which affects usability.
risks.proof: A photo showing the power brick and signal cable included.

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, dents, broken stand) not visible due to low light/angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of screen surface, back casing, and stand joint in good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unknown, assume worn

proof_requests: Video of monitor powering on with a visible image.
Video of keyboard typing on a working machine.
Photo of power adapter and video cable included in sale.
Close-up photos of screen surface and back casing in good lighting.
response.reason: The LG monitor and generic keyboard are clearly identifiable by brand/type, and the seller's own 'scrap' label combined with the unverified power-on state means the set must be priced at worst case (non-working) until proof of function is given.
